details: MA5 participates in Aligned_bull; Volume_MA5 defines Volume_ratio. No separate 5-day high/low/range selector in official candidate path.
Range/payoff experiments use lag1~5 feature state and evolve per-individual feature weights/cuts to identify next-day high/low payoff patterns.
Stage2 path filter uses high5/low5/range/pullback-like pre-signal trajectory genes but has no live wiring.
q<45 is a hand-built current-state quality heuristic at shadow OPEN. It does not train or emit a rulebook and has no forward-2-day return label.
signal_threshold is a GA gene on composite indicator/news/event score. It is not the range predictor's dense cut and is not calibrated to +2~3% within two days.
No import/call/artifact linkage from range/payoff experimental predictor into live_candidate_slots, evaluator, or CRS final rulebook lineage.

details: Implemented pieces: individualized cuts, five-day lag features, forward payoff/high target experiments. Missing/changed pieces: exact two-day horizon, fixed +2~3% percentage target, promotion into current Stage2/Stage3/live candidate rulebook.
